notice: Prototype checklist adapted from the qualification file assessment criteria; it includes selected criteria from MSME/DIE/01–03 and all 17 listed PCs from MSME/DIE/04. Verify evidence and apply the official rubric; the assessor makes the decision. Electrical practicals require qualified supervision and approved, isolated, de-energized training equipment.

items.criterion: Observe safety precautions while working with electricity.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to explain and demonstrate the applicable safety precautions in a controlled assessment setup.

items.criterion: Explain safe handling of tools and equipment, identify electrician tools, and select a suitable tool for a task.
items.evidence_prompt: Present approved tools and a task scenario; observe the worker's selection and explanation.

items.criterion: Select and use appropriate electrical meters and measuring instruments for the stated measurement.
items.evidence_prompt: Use an assessor-approved, de-energized training setup or safe simulator and observe instrument selection and use.

items.criterion: Identify types of wire joints and prepare the specified wire joint.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to identify and prepare a selected joint using safe training materials.

items.criterion: Design and wire a simple household electrical circuit.
items.evidence_prompt: Have the worker plan and assemble the circuit on an approved training board under assessor supervision.

items.criterion: Test a wiring installation using a megger.
items.evidence_prompt: Observe the worker use an approved training installation and instrument, following assessor safety controls.

items.criterion: Identify and repair a fault in a wiring installation.
items.evidence_prompt: Present a safe simulated fault on training equipment; observe fault identification and repair process.

items.criterion: Draw the symbols and abbreviations used in transformer design.
items.evidence_prompt: Give a transformer-design drawing task and ask the worker to identify and use the relevant symbols and abbreviations.

items.criterion: Define magnetic flux, leakage flux, magnetizing force, and flux density.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to explain each term and distinguish them using a diagram or trainer model.

items.criterion: Explain the working principle of a simple transformer.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to explain primary and secondary windings and electromagnetic induction using a diagram or isolated low-voltage trainer.

items.criterion: Explain hysteresis and eddy-current losses in magnetic material.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to describe both losses and identify design choices that reduce them.

items.criterion: Describe core-material properties and identify common core types.
items.evidence_prompt: Present labeled sample materials or a diagram and ask the worker to describe properties relevant to a transformer core.

items.criterion: Select a suitable transformer core size and shape for a stated design.
items.evidence_prompt: Provide a design specification and core options; ask the worker to select and explain a suitable size and shape.

items.criterion: Explain basic considerations when designing transformer windings.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to explain winding arrangement and the design factors they would check for the stated transformer.

items.criterion: Describe characteristics of super-enamelled copper wire.
items.evidence_prompt: Show labeled wire samples or specifications and ask the worker to explain the relevant conductor and insulation characteristics.

items.criterion: Select an appropriate copper-conductor size for a transformer design.
items.evidence_prompt: Provide a low-voltage training design and conductor options; ask the worker to select and justify a size using the applicable reference data.

items.criterion: Select suitable insulation for winding a transformer coil.
items.evidence_prompt: Present an application and approved insulation options; ask the worker to select and explain a suitable choice.

items.criterion: Wind a coil for a specified training transformer and assemble the core with the coil.
items.evidence_prompt: Observe on an approved, guarded, de-energized training winding machine under qualified supervision; do not use an energized transformer.

items.criterion: Explain tests appropriate for a transformer.
items.evidence_prompt: Ask the worker to name and explain relevant transformer tests and the safety controls required before testing.

items.criterion: Explain temperature rise and its effect on transformer performance.
items.evidence_prompt: Present a temperature scenario or readings from a safe trainer and ask the worker to explain likely effects on performance.

items.criterion: State and apply transformer-design equations to a stated problem.
items.evidence_prompt: Give a paper-based or simulator exercise; check equation choice, units, substitutions, and result.

items.criterion: Prepare a design for a main transformer up to 5 kVA.
items.evidence_prompt: Use a paper-based design exercise with supplied requirements and approved reference data; assess the design calculations, not construction on live equipment.

items.criterion: Design a transformer for a voltage-stabilizer application.
items.evidence_prompt: Provide a voltage-stabilizer training specification and approved reference data; ask the worker to prepare and explain the design.

items.criterion: Operate, repair, and maintain a transformer winding machine.
items.evidence_prompt: Observe only on an approved, guarded machine under qualified supervision; verify isolation, guarding, safe operation, and maintenance or repair procedures.
